image_description: A close-up shot of a human foot, specifically the heel and ankle area. A standard beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) is applied diagonally across the heel. The bandage features a central white absorbent pad with a visible mesh texture and tan adhesive wings. The skin appears smooth with some natural creases near the ankle. The background consists of dark, out-of-focus fabric, likely clothing.
